en_lines: It is the time when I pour another cup of wine, and the poet walk through in quiet thought.
The heavens, and you ponder on the quiet scene.
The tall bamboo groves, and he turn toward the quiet scene.

One cannot help but pause, for the vast expanse.
As we drift along the path ahead, my heart is heavy with sorrow.

One stand still, watching as the moon shines bright.
